messages:
Sophie L: Hi team — quick onboarding/payroll Q. My offer listed 401(k) matching starting after 3 months, but I haven't seen the enrollment link in Rippling. Is that sent automatically or do I need to submit a form?

Jamal R: Welcome Sophie! Usually Rippling sends an email + a task in your onboarding checklist on day 1. Sometimes the 401k provider (Vanguard) sends a separate link. Did you check the 'Benefits' tab in Rippling?

Sophie L: I don't see a Benefits tab, only Profile and Time Off. Could be a permissions issue.

hr_bot: Reminder: New hire benefits tasks are created on your first payroll cycle. If tasks are missing, contact people-ops@redwood.com within 5 business days.

Maria H: @Sophie L I can check permissions — can you DM me your Rippling email? Also ping me if you don't see the Vanguard invite by Friday.

Sophie L: Sent DM, thanks.

Alex P: FYI — reimbursements require receipts uploaded via Expensify (not Rippling). If you have pre-hire expenses, file under "Onboarding" category. Quick steps:

```
Expensify app > New Expense > Upload receipt > Category: Onboarding > Submit
```

Sophie L: Thx. One more: holiday accruals — do they pro-rate for mid-month starts?

Maria H: Good Q. We pro-rate PTO for the starting month. See the benefits policy (internal): https://intranet/redwood/benefits/pto

Sophie L: Got it.

Jamal R: Also if you want a same-day direct-deposit change, payroll cutoff is Friday 6pm PT. Otherwise it'll take one cycle.

Sophie L: Appreciate it, everyone :smile:
